metadata.description: Probe: examine and sharpen concepts from six critical angles, in Claude Code.

plugins.name: probe
plugins.description: Use /probe to have agents sharpen ideas at any stage, like when your thinking is still raw and messy or after each draft is written. It can run six critical agents individually or in parallel and synthesizes an actionable verdict. Run /probe:go to launch all six lenses in parallel and synthesize the findings. Learn more at https://probe.md
